svg.text: Admin & operations platform · one permission model, three role-scoped portals
Permissions from System Config route the user
Complete control — all 12 modules including governance
Every module follows the same interior pattern: overview → filterable data table → record detail → focused modal actions. Destructive and financial actions carry confirmation or approval steps.
System Config (amber) is the control plane: permissions set there determine which of the three portals — and which actions inside them — a user ever sees.
